name: Noa von Leonstein
original_name: ノア・フォン・レオンシュタイン
source:
"Eheh, thank you to all Pegasus members for all the help you've given to my brother."

- Affiliation: Academia Affiliated School
- Birthday: February 14
- Height: 150cm
- Three Size: B78(B)/W58/H80
- Likes: Her brother's paintings
- Dislikes: Courtly ties
[spoiler]- Will/Gem: "Velvet Dandelion Flower Snowstorm" Rhodonite Lion Heart[/spoiler]

The first princess of Phrygia's royal family, Markus' younger sister.
She is also top-elite of Academia Affiliated School.
With her graceful appearance and noble-like manner, she is indubitably the most brilliant princess in a pure sense.
Although she is an affiliated student, she has a mature side that cannot be underestimated.
People have a common perception that she is "The refined sister in contrast with the indecorous brother."

[Translated from [url=https://cabbage-soft.com/products/jewelry/character/]Official Website[/url]]
